description: The record example in .agent/docs/semantic-fixpoint.md (%Point{x: 1} / %Size{w: 2.0} share one activation) is correct, but only because the unset fields hold nil, a literal atom, so the records are not ground and take the demand path. Probe on develop 353b2ab2f: that example gives sink/1 1 key (map); %Point{x: 1, y: 2} / %Size{w: 3, h: 4} gives 2 keys. The doc should state the ground rule and the contrasting case.
title: semantic-fixpoint.md: say why its record example shares one activation
